note: Literature reports both monoallelic and biallelic (truncating and missense) NAV3 variants presenting with variable neurodevelopmental and speech phenotypes.

evidence.text: Affected individuals with predicted pathogenic biallelic, de novo, and heterozygous variants in NAV3 present with overlapping neurodevelopmental phenotypes across inheritance modes.

source.title: Variants of NAV3, a neuronal morphogenesis protein, cause intellectual disability, developmental delay, and microcephaly
source.quote: We report eleven individuals from seven families harboring predicted pathogenic biallelic, de novo, and heterozygous variants in the NAV3 gene, which encodes the microtubule positive tip protein neuron navigator 3 (NAV3).

evidence.text: Identification of a homozygous missense variant in NAV3 expands the allelic spectrum in autosomal recessive neurodevelopmental disorders involving speech features.

source.title: NAV3 Missense Variant in a Homozygous State: Strengthening Links to Neurodevelopmental Disorder
source.quote: The identification of a novel biallelic missense variant in NAV3 adds a new layer to our understanding of its potential contribution to autosomal recessive neurodevelopmental disorders.
